solutions.title: Choose/skip with result set
solutions.strategy: Sort candidates, explore choose/skip decisions for every index, and let a set remove duplicate value rows.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every subset can be explored and copied into the result set.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The dedupe set may hold many copied combinations plus recursion state.

solutions.title: Sorted backtracking with duplicate skip
solutions.strategy: At each depth, iterate forward and skip equal values already considered at that same depth.

timeComplexity.explanation: The valid subset search is still exponential in the worst case, with copying cost per answer.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Ignoring output, the path and recursion stack are bounded by the number of candidates.
